strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor today on this abrasive Road America surface. Managing those tires is crucial for a strong finish.
With a lap distance of 6.515km, fuel consumption will be a key consideration; teams will be closely monitoring their fuel levels throughout the race.
The pit window here at Road America is relatively long, so teams will need to carefully consider the timing of their stops.
